rule: Seeing a newer build publishes the resulting notice change.
Applying a GM command publishes the resulting change.
A player delta withdraws record keys that are no longer visible.
A withdrawn pending key is sent again as its replica record.
Only the first part of a split delta carries withdrawn keys.
A repeated projection nonce is answered only once.
Restarting a stream assigns a new engine id.
A record with a changed version is sent even when its key is already held.
A player pending overlay is used when deriving known records (#60).
A player role takes the pending-overlay branch (#61).
Each pending player record overrides its replica record in known records (#62).
The pending player map becomes the known-record source (#63).
A no-fit projection is rejected instead of treated as successful (#38).
A no-fit projection reports its split error (#40).
A settled projection releases its answering nonce through the send chain (#49).
A settled projection deletes its answering nonce (#50).
Every restart leaves one unconditional cue pending.
